hc-grnhse___suki___8202889003.description:
What we want to accomplish and why we need you 
Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions. Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we’re striving to do even better. Come and join us!
We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctors. We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. Check out this short video to learn more about our mission and our culture.
 About the Role: 
As Enterprise Customer Success Manager, your primary role is to drive the successful implementation, deployment and adoption of Suki with our major health system clients. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, and ensuring that Suki is delivering exceptionally well on key success metrics. You will ensure strategic and tactical alignment, and manage on-time delivery across all functional areas with our clients and your Suki colleagues. You will be responsible for proactively identifying and driving the resolution of risks and issues, and developing creative solutions that will best meet the needs of our clients. You will also manage the onboarding process overall for your designated clients, and be responsible for conducting the onboarding for many enterprise end users. Throughout the client relationship, you will present periodic performance reviews and engage with our clients on opportunities to expand usage and value in partnership. You are able to analyze customer metrics, craft high-impact client presentations, and drive rapid progress against our goals.
As part of our growing Customer Success team, you will also be responsible for improving existing processes and developing new approaches to create high levels of client and user satisfaction. You will also engage with Marketing on opportunities to increase user engagement and provide structured customer insights to our Product team to inform future innovation. You are excited to join the fast-moving Suki team, and committed to excellence!
 Responsibilities and expectations include but are not limited to: 
 Executive-Level Presence and Communications: Ability to communicate both internally and externally with professionalism in person, on video, on the phone, and over email with C-level executives, providers and colleagues.
 Revenue Ownership: We believe in a true ownership model. You will be focused on expanding revenue within our existing customer base, overseeing competitive renewals, upsells and cross-sells, and driving commercial strategy in collaboration. You will own and forecast renewal and expansion revenue metrics, delivering against quarterly and annual targets.
 Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-moving organization that uses light-weight processes and cutting-edge technology to have a huge impact.
 High-Accountability: You can be counted on to consistently deliver high-quality work.
 User-focused: You are obsessed with the customer experience. You can translate key consumer needs into business and product requirements. You have an innate understanding of user behavior, and ensure users are receiving 100% quality service.
 Detail Oriented: You need a high degree of attention to small details along with the a
[...]
or a Technology Innovation Leadership award, just to name a few.
 Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful tech veterans from Google and Apple and medical leaders from UCSF and Stanford. We have technologists and doctors working side-by-side to solve complex problems.
 Great investors: We’re backed by Venrock, First Round Capital, Flare Capital, March Capital, Hedosophia and others. With our $165M raised so far, we have the resources to scale.
 Huge market: Disrupting a massive, growing $30+ billion market for transcription, dictation, and order-entry solutions. Our vision is to become the voice user interface for healthcare, relieving the administrative burden on doctors instead of adding to it.
 Great customers: Our solutions are used in health systems and clinics across the country, supporting clinicians across dozens of specialties. Check out what one of our users says about how Suki has helped give her a sense of balance.
 Impact: You’ll make an impact from day one. You’ll join a team working towards a shared purpose with a culture built upon deep empathy for doctors and passion for making their lives better.
Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.
In compliance with the State of California Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is between $150,000 - $180,000 OTE in CA. This range is not inclusive of any discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

Description

You’ll be the primary point of contact for assigned partner institutions, leading onboarding, integrations, and training efforts while building long-term relationships that drive adoption, expansion, and retention. Your goal is not only to support teams but to energize them to achieve more than they thought possible with BoodleBox.

Comfortable managing onboarding processes including kickoff calls, SSO/LMS integrations, and training delivery.
Comfortable analyzing adoption data and customer metrics to guide engagement and decisions.
Strong communicator who can influence administrators, faculty, and staff at all levels.
A keen interest in AI’s application in education and a passion to learn, experiment, and apply generative AI in your own work.

A relationship-driven professional who can build trust with higher education leaders and teams.
A proactive problem solver who anticipates customer needs and delivers solutions before issues arise.
A confident leader to facilitate strategic conversations with administrators and energize faculty/staff.
A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment and balances multiple priorities with ease.
A curious learner who is excited about generative AI and passionate about transforming education.

Who We Are
BoodleBox is a team of curious, collaborative builders. We are committed to creating meaningful experiences for our customers and each other. Our culture values:
A desire to learn and grow
A willingness to question and innovate
A focus on building strong relationships and community
A drive to deliver impact in higher education

 Mission That Matters: Help reshape how higher education adopts generative AI by empowering faculty, staff, and students to collaborate responsibly.
 High-Growth Opportunity: Join a VC-backed company scaling quickly with room to grow your career as we expand.

Opportunities for career growth and professional development in a fast-growing company.
A collaborative and supportive remote work environment where your contributions directly impact the future of education.

BoodleBox is a VC-backed GenAI platform built for higher education. Our platform brings together leading AI tools — including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity — under one roof, purpose-built for the unique demands of academic environments. We're guided by three core values: service, education, and collaboration.

As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com. 
 ROLE SUMMARY 
 HealthEdge's customer success strategy depends on four organizational capabilities: achieving customer outcomes, retaining and converting referenceable customers, expanding revenue within the existing customer base, and maintaining data and reporting integrity. The CSE is an essential delivery partner in all four — owning defined workstreams, managing critical relationship layers, and keeping the operational machinery of customer success running with precision. 
 This is not a support role. It is an outcome ownership role at a defined scope. A CSE at HealthEdge is accountable for the workstreams they own within the customer's success plan — and for keeping those workstreams current, honest, and moving without being asked. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Responsibilities are organized by the four strategic outcomes the CSE organization exists to deliver. These are not task lists — they are outcome areas with clear accountability. 
 Customer Outcomes 
 Own defined workstreams within the Customer Success Plan for every assigned account — keeping your sections current, evidence-based, and tied to the customer's business objectives , not HealthEdge's delivery milestones.

 Customer Retention & Referenceability 
 Surface account risk before the customer does — identify the signal, act on it, and flag it appropriately with context already framed: what you're seeing, why it matters, and what you recommend. 
 Own assigned pieces of the Path to Green plan for every at-risk account — keep the issue list current and honest, track every action to closure, and never let a recovery item die in a seam. 
 Support reference-development plans by maintaining strong VP/Director relationships that make customers willing, credible advocates. 
 Customer Revenue Expansion

 Know the basics of each assigned account's contract — what was bought, key SLAs, renewal timing — well enough to recognize when an operational issue has c lient implications and flag it immediately . 
 Support clean handoffs to Sales when expansion opportunities are identified — nothing falls in the seam. 
 Data & Reporting Discipline

 Flag data gaps or health score discrepancies proactively — don't let a reporting issue become a surprise.

Robust.ai builds Carter, a collaborative robot that works alongside warehouse associates in order picking at third-party logistics and manufacturing sites. As a Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of customer accounts from go-live to renewal. You make sure each customer gets the uptime and throughput they bought, you prove that value in numbers, and you find where the next robots and sites should go.
You are the customer's single point of contact once a site is live. Our Deployment team launches the sites, our Fleet team fixes the robots, and our CS Operations & Insights team provides the data. You make all of it add up to a customer who renews and expands. Commercial owns pricing and contracts; you work alongside them on every renewal and expansion.
 What you'll own 
 The relationship. Become the named owner for your accounts at SAT sign-off. Build ties from the floor supervisor to the site GM and the customer's executive sponsor.
 Account health. Track uptime, adoption, and throughput for every site in your portfolio. Grade each site weekly (Navigation, Uptime, Adoption, Customer Sentiment) and act on the gaps before the customer raises them.
 Business reviews. Run QBRs that show the customer what Carter delivered, in their numbers (orders, lines per hour, labor hours), and agree what improves next quarter.
 Escalations. When a site is down or a customer is unhappy, own the customer conversation while Fleet (Support) restores service. Keep Commercial and leadership informed the same day on anything that threatens an account.
 Voice of the customer. Turn what you hear on site into ranked feature requests and repeat-fault reports for Product and Engineering.
 Renewals. Deliver a renewal brief to Commercial 120 days before each term ends: value delivered, open risks, sentiment and the recommended path.
 Expansion. Spot more volume, new workflows, and new sites in your accounts. Qualify them and bring in Commercial, who prices and closes.
 Customer-facing programs. Help shape and deliver premium support, references, and case studies.
 How we'll measure success 
 Net revenue retention across your portfolio: customers renew and grow.

Spanish (one customer site is in Mexico City).

About the role: 
 As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will be accountable for the success and retention of Bonusly's customers, establishing yourself as a Trusted Advisor and proactively providing best practice guidance and recommendations to maximize the value customers realize from Bonusly . We are looking for someone with an ingrained passion for people, and a love for finding creative solutions to help others c reate a culture of appreciation within their organization. 
 You will become an expert on employee recognition and the Bonusly app while managing our customer’s success throughout the customer lifecycle. From ensuring that Bonusly customers are on-boarded successfully, to seeing that they achieve their business and talent goals using our product, you’ll directly affect the customer satisfaction, retention, growth, and advocacy of our amazing customers! 
 ✅ What you'll do: 
 Manage a portfolio of ~200 customers in the SMB to Mid-Market and Enterprise space throughout the life cycle, owning their ultimate success by ensuring they realize the full value of the Bonusly platform. 
 Ownership of the retention and growth of your book of business, including upsell opportunities and renewal negotiations. 
 Follow an engagement model based on customer size—using scalable solutions like best practice webinars and automation to drive adoption and reduce renewal risks for smaller clients, while delivering personalized 1:1 support for larger accounts. 
 Be a trusted advisor to your clients, consulting on best practices to drive a thriving, high performing culture and help them achieve their company goals. 
 Drive product adoption and ongoing usage of Bonusly by helping our customers follow best practices to get the most from Bonusly (and, help define what those best practices are!) 
 Serve as the voice of your customers by sharing customer feedback and advocating for customer needs cross-departmentally and serve as the Voice of Bonusly with our customers to ensure mutual success in the partnership. 
 Keep up with HR industry trends to understand and advise our customers. 
 💚 You’re a great fit if you… 
 3+ years of Customer Success Manager experience within the B2B SaaS space, ideally within HRTech. 
 Have experience owning the entire customer lifecycle from on-boarding to renewals. 
 Have a strong drive to understand clients’ business goals, anticipate future needs, and work relentlessly to help your clients achieve success. 
 Excel at identifying problems, discovering root causes, and working quickly to find long-term solutions. 
 Are well-organized and detail-oriented, with a keen understanding of project management. 
 Adept with standard business tools and practices, and able to learn new ones quickly. 
 Thrive in a fast-paced work environment and are adaptable to change. 
 Compensation: 
 Base Salary: $90,000 - $140,000 
 Variable based on retention and equity options are also included . 
 About Bonusly: 
 Bonusly helps your team improve engagement and adopt the behaviors that set them, and your organization, up for long-term success. We make employee recognition meaningful, habitual, and connected to what matters most—helping organizations build cultures where people want to stay and grow together. To learn more about working at Bonusly, check out our Un-Handbook: https://github.com/bonusly/un-handbook

About the role 
 Flexible on location (ideally can travel to either London, Cheltenham or Wakefield office) 
 The Commercial Operations Team will bring together renewals, sales support and commercial administration into a single specialist, customer facing function. 
 The team will support sales in all areas of the sales cycle, reducing the amount of time being spent on administrative tasks. Its purpose is not to replace sales, it’s to work alongside sales, in partnership, enabling sales to sell more efficiently and effectively. 
 Maximise the time sales spend selling, removing administrative burdens. 
 Proactive management of renewals and commercial opportunities. 
 Provide exceptional commercial/sales support to customers. 
 Improve consistency across relevant commercial processes. 
 Provide accurate commercial reporting and insight. 
 Engage customers directly to retain with better commercial offers when cease requests are received. 
 Continually improve commercial efficiency through process improvement/automation. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 The Commercial Operations Specialist will be a multi-skilled individual, supporting sales to perform key aspects of the sales cycle. These include renewals, sales support and commercial administration. 
 Renewals 
 Working alongside sales to manage the end-to-end customer renewals process 
 Proactively tracking customer renewals (planning & reporting) 
 Create renewals packs for customers (identify upsell opportunities) 
 Engage with vendors for the best commercial offer 
 Contract analysis & pricing validation 
 Process renewals directly or provide the AM with the details 
 Supporting renewals campaigns 
 Knowledge of renewals across all products (including Mitel and Avaya) 
 Following up on cease requests, contacting customers to take every action to prevent customer churn 
 Process renewals in the system (e.g. updating billing dates in aBILLity or “resigning” with a supplier) 
 Sales Support 
 Interacting with customers to manage customer queries/issues 
 Managing customer quote requests (e.g. negotiating around internal teams for product spec/pricing etc.) 
 Finalising supplier pricing 
 Producing and checking/managing customer opportunities/deals in hubspot 
 Creating & sharing commercial proposals with customers 
 Completing customer order forms 
 Sharing customer contracts and managing contract queries 
 Using Clevr360 to create sales review packs for customers, at sales request 
 Commercial Operations 
 CRM governance/reporting – owning the data related to renewals & sales support 
 Sales forecast support 
 Provide commercial insights from customer interactions 
 Campaign administration 
 What the Team Does Not Own 
 Account ownership 
 Commercial negotiations with customers 
 Technical pre-sales 
 Project delivery 
 Operational support, however, will be expected to liaise with other teams to support customer queries rather than simply handing off responsibility 
 Success Measures 
 The Commercial Operations Team will be governed by the following success measures - 
 Increased selling time for Account Managers, through reduced administrative burden. 
 Improved visibility of renewals; upcoming, completed, pillars, values etc. 
 Improved renewal conversation (lower customer churn). 
 Improved customer engagement; faster quote turnaround & response times. 
 Improved CRM data quality in relevant areas. 
 Greater commercial consistency across renewals and sales support. 
 About CloudClevr 
 Our vision is simple: a world where technology helps you to achieve your technology goals with the confidence that outcomes will be achieved and a return on investment will be delivered. Where you have a clear, measurable technology roadmap, transparency on performance and trust in the security of your technology estate. 
 Our mission is to increase confidence in technology transformation and remove doubt and uncertainty through our technology expertise, our partnerships with our customers and through Clevr360, our unique software platform. 
 Our carefully curated, world-class solutions boost collaboration, productivity and customer satisfaction. We work with you in partnership to ensure our services meet your specific needs. We call this our Customer Technology Partnership. 
 Our differentiation comes from technology but also in the way we work with our customers, the results we deliver, the commitment we show and the continued investment in our team’s expertise across our technology practices.

 On It : We take ownership, follow through, and get things done.

 The Role 
 Day-to-day at Ekco: 
The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the relationship for every customer in one of Ekco's Flex pods, at every tier, and is their trusted advisor. You work alongside the Technical Account Manager who covers the pod and the Account Manager, and you are the named deputy for another Flex pod's customers. A Tier 1 or Tier 2 customer in the Aligned pod is also assigned to a Senior Customer Success Manager, agreed by the Director of Customer Success. Ekco meets every contractual commitment, and you make sure it does. The conversation you lead goes further: for customers in the cloud it is about service requests, efficiency, FinOps and how their estate evolves; for customers still mainly on-premises it is about running well today and planning the next step. Make sure each new customer has the handbook, contacts and escalation routes at the start of service, and record them in the customer's Customer Service Record.
Keep each customer's Customer Service Record current: the named deputy, the agreed cadence, and whether the customer has a named TAM or the Technical Account Management team.
Lead service reviews and business reviews, at the cadence set by the customer's tier and with the Account Manager owning the commercial content, that focus on outcomes, adoption, cost and roadmap, with the pod's service performance as one input rather than the whole agenda.
Own relationship NPS and the feedback loop for assigned accounts; ticket CSAT sits with the Pod Leader. Aim for a net positive NPS, act on the written feedback rather than the score alone, and close the loop with the customer.
Own customer complaints for your accounts, with the Pod Leader responsible for the pod's part in resolving them.

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.
Our Mission
Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.
 Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

As a Senior Customer Success Engineer at Tyk, you'll be a strategic and technical leader within the Customer Success organization. You're the person people turn to when things get complex, whether technical, customer-facing, operational or cross-functional.

Act as an escalation point for systemic issues, leading incident resolution. Escalations come to you before going to Product.
Work with Senior and Principal engineers across regions to resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
Guide triage practices so issues are isolated quickly and accurately across the team.
 Mentorship and team development 
Coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers in your region on technical depth, customer engagement, ownership and handling complex situations independently.
Set a high standard for technical quality, communication, accountability and customer ownership.
Flag capability gaps to Customer Success leadership and help close them through training, documentation and hiring input.
Support engineers through complex cases while building their confidence to lead them independently.
Foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing, collaboration and constructive feedback.
 Proactive customer engagement 
Build trusted relationships with key Enterprise customers through regular account syncs, acting as their senior technical partner.
Lead onboardings and regular syncs for Enterprise customers, whose complex environments need senior-level judgement. Onboardings are complet

 our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
Employee share scheme
Generous maternity and paternity leave
Company retreats
We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated.  Assume best intent!

About Strategus 
 Strategus is an advertising technology company that helps brands and agencies drive measurable business outcomes through data-driven strategy, cross-channel media, and transparent reporting across every screen. From CTV and online video to display, streaming audio, and digital out-of-home, Strategus aligns every channel around the business results that matter most.
 Our culture is grounded in three values: Respect, Full Engagement, and Growth. They shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for clients and one another. Our north star is simple: make Strategus the best job you’ve ever had. That means building a high-performing team where people are trusted to contribute, supported in their development, and empowered to shape what comes next. Together, we’re helping define the future of CTV and programmatic advertising while delivering smarter outcomes for the clients who count on us. 
 About the role 
 Strategus is building a modern, insight-led sales organization for 2027, and we're looking for a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead to help get us there. Reporting to the EVP of Sales, you'll own new-seller onboarding, ongoing sales training, the sales playbook, and adoption of the tools our sellers use every day, including Salesforce, Gong, sales-intent and prospecting tools, and approved AI tools. 
 This is a hands-on role focused on how sellers work, not on forecasting, spreadsheet-heavy reporting, or sales-planning models. You'll measure whether training and tools are changing seller behavior, and partner with managers to close the gaps. 
 What you'll be doing as a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead: 
 Own the sales enablement strategy, program calendar, and day-to-day execution, aligned with Sales leadership's priorities 
 Build role-based learning paths covering Strategus positioning, products, sales methodology, core selling skills, sales processes, and tools 
 Run new-seller onboarding from day one through full productivity, with clear ramp milestones, practice assignments, and certifications 
 Partner with frontline managers to assess readiness through role-plays, account work, live opportunities, and Gong call reviews, and build targeted 30-day plans when a seller misses a milestone 
 Deliver ongoing training for new and experienced sellers on prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and client handoffs 
 Reinforce Challenger, MEDDIC, and other methods adopted by Sales leadership through real examples and live opportunities 
 Partner with Marketing, Product, and Planning to turn product launches, market insights, and approved messaging into seller-ready training 
 Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, practice exercises, and reinforcement plans so learning continues in team meetings, one-on-ones, and deal coaching 
 Drive adoption of Salesforce, sales-intent and prospecting tools, Gong, and approved AI tools, and teach sellers the practical workflow for each 
 Turn approved AI capabilities into everyday seller workflows for research, meeting prep, and drafting, with clear guidance on responsible use and protecting client information 
 Own the sales playbook and keep onboarding materials, job aids, recordings, and call examples current and easy to find 
 Track onboarding progress, certifications, proficiency, and tool adoption, and re-measure after each program to confirm seller behavior improved 
 Partner with platform owners on requirements, testing, and rollout of system improvements 
 Share regular, action-oriented updates with Sales leadership on progress, gaps, and recommended next steps 
 Qualifications: 
 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, revenue or sales operations, or a related commercial role 
 Proven track record of building and running onboarding and ongoing training programs that improve ramp and seller performance 
 Hands-on experience driving CRM adoption, preferably Salesforce, through practical training, workflow design, and manager reinforcement 
 Experience with Gong or a similar conversation-intelligence platform for coaching and skill development 
 Familiarity with sales-intent and prospecting tools and how sellers use them to prioritize accounts and personalize outreach 
 Experience teaching sales methodologies such as Challenger or MEDDIC 
 Ability to create clear learning paths, role-plays, job aids, certifications, and playbooks 
 Comfortable using adoption data, performance signals, and field feedback to find gaps and show what's working 
 Practical experience with AI-enabled sales workflows and sound judgment about protecting client and company information 
 Excellent facilitation, coaching, writing, and project-management skills, with credibility among sellers, managers, and sales leaders 
 A hands-on, change-oriented approach focused on helping people apply new skills, not just delivering training 
 Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, or media sales preferred 
 Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred 
 We offer a base salary of $100,000-$120,000, but that's just the starting point. This role includes a profit share bonus of up to 15%, plus a full benefits package, because we believe in rewarding the people who help us grow.
 Strategus is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion, as well as non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability unrelated to performing the essential task of the job or other legally protected categories. If you're smart, scrappy and good at what you do, come as you are. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

**Role:** Sales Operations Coordinator, Power Generation
**The Role**
We’re hiring a Sales Coordinator to be the organizational backbone of our generator sales team. You’ll support our technical sales representatives as they sell, quote, and specify standby and prime power systems for agricultural, commercial, industrial, institutional and residential customers.
Our reps spend most of their time in the field with customers, engineers, and contractors. You’ll keep everything moving behind them. You’ll assist with the fulfillment of accepted quotes, track orders from PO to delivery, and make sure no customer or deadline slips through the cracks. If you love juggling priorities, enjoy learning technical products and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you.
**About Us**
ANSER Power Systems Inc. is an Abbotsford-based electrical contracting, power generation and gas fitting company. Since 2012 we’ve built a reputation for high-quality work, especially in agriculture, where we serve dairy, poultry, greenhouse and processing operations. Our work goes well beyond the farm too, with projects for schools, pump stations and even aircraft hangars. That variety makes for an interesting workplace with plenty of room to grow.
We have a team of nearly 80 and a strong history of growth, and our success is built on a culture that puts employee well-being first. We believe happy, respected people do their best work, so we build mutual respect, trust and open communication. We’re looking for people who share our values: professionalism, hard work and real pride in delivering work that consistently exceeds expectations.
**What You’ll Do**
*Quoting and Sales Support*
· Assist with preparation of generator quotes and proposals
· Respond to inbound inquiries by phone, email, and web form, qualify leads, and book site assessments
· Enter and track leads, quotes, and orders in our CRM, and follow up on open quotes
· Request pricing and lead times from manufacturers and distributors
· Create and maintain sales items in our product catalogue
· Assist with the preparation of submittal packages (spec sheets, drawings, and warranty info) for engineers and contractors
· Track tender and bid deadlines and help assemble bid documents
· Build and maintain quote templates, price lists, and standard option packages
*Order Management*
· Process signed orders: confirm deposits, order equipment from manufacturers and distributors, and track delivery dates
· Check order acknowledgments from suppliers against the quote and PO
· Compare open purchases orders to monthly open order reports from suppliers
· Work with our installation and service teams, electricians, and gas fitters to schedule installs
· Coordinate startup and commissioning with the service team
· Order accessories such as transfer switches, pads, enclosures, and fuel tanks
· Track back-ordered parts and warn customers early when timelines slip
· Coordinate freight, site delivery, and offloading or crane needs
*Customer Care*
· Keep customers updated from order through commissioning and answer their questions along the way
· Handle the first round of complaints or escalations and send them to the right person
· Build long-term relationships with customers, general contractors, and suppliers
· Confirm warranty registrations and promote service and maintenance agreements after install
· Hand over owner’s manuals, warranty documents, and maintenance schedules
· Set up maintenance agreement renewals and reminders
· Send post-install follow-ups or satisfaction surveys
*Billing and Admin*
· Set up new customer accounts and credit applications
· Prepare progress billing and final invoices
· Follow up on overdue deposits and payments
*Reporting and Growth*
· Prepare weekly sales pipeline and order status reports for the sales manager
· Track quote win rates, lost-sale reasons, and how long jobs take from order to install
· Help find new opportunities in the agricultural, commercial, and residential markets
· Build customer lists for targeted campaigns, such as farms due for backup power upgrades
· Support trade shows, home shows, and marketing campaigns as needed
· Keep sales collateral, brochures, and website product info up to date
· Help with dealer or manufacturer program requirements, such as co-op marketing claims and rebates
· Track competitor pricing and product info that reps bring back from the field
**What You’ll Bring**
*Required*
· Strong organization and the ability to manage many orders and deadlines at once
· Clear, friendly communication by phone, email and in person
· Comfort with CRM software and Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
· Valid driver's licence
*Nice to Have*
· 2+ years in sales support, sales coordination, customer service or office administration
· Experience in generators, electrical, HVAC, construction or another trades-based business
· Familiarity with brands such as Teksan, Cummins, Caterpillar, etc.
· Experience reading basic electrical specs or quoting equipment
· Business administration degree or a related field
Pay: $24.00-$30.00 per hour
Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Casual dress
* Company events

LouwersHanique is a company of IDEX Corporation.
We are supplier of customer-specific solutions and precision components using technical glass, ceramics and special material combinations.
 We Facilitate the Next Generation of Technologies

For LouwersHanique, this means adapting and continuously developing our manufacturing capacity and processes.
We are based in the Eindhoven region (Brainport) and help solve some of the most complicated, high-tech industrial issues. As a long-term partner of several leading high-tech companies around the world, we tackle the toughest challenges and strive for perfection.
 Our Method
 We achieve the best results through close cooperation with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of a product. From prototype to mass production of critical components. LouwersHanique can act as an extension of an R&D or engineering team and is happy to be involved in an NPI project from the start. This enables us to anticipate design considerations and select the right materials from the start.
We strongly believe in long-term partnerships with customers and suppliers. Long-term partnerships do not just happen and are based on mutual trust. These businesses include: Advanced Thin Films, Inc., CVI Laser, LLC, CVI Laser Limited, Iridian Spectral Technologies Ltd., Superior Technical Ceramics Corp (STC), Tecan Limited, Veco B.V., Atul, Veco Precision India Pvt. Ltd (VPI), Millux B.V., and Louwers Hanique B.V.

NPI & Project Alignment

Align the customer’s need timeline with our production scheduling to ensure projects are delivered on time to launch.

communication skills.

 Sales commissions

Excellent English communication skills and professionalism when working with executives and sales leaders.

SQL or Python skills, French language skills, and an interest in systems and automation

Career-defining opportunities

Strategic mindset combined with a practical, structured, and delivery-focused approach.

Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.
Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.
As our Compensation Manager, you will own how Profound pays and motivates its go-to-market team. Sitting within GTM Operations, you will partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to design incentive plans that drive the right behavior, and you will run the comp engine behind them: calculations, systems, and payouts. You will work very closely with our Payroll team so every rep is paid accurately and on time, and with Finance so plans are modeled, budgeted, and accounted for correctly. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will build the comp function's systems, processes, and controls as our GTM team scales.
 What You’ll Do
 Incentive design
Own incentive plan design across GTM roles, including Account Executives, SDRs, Account Managers, Engagement Managers, and other Post-Sales and Sales roles
Partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention) into plan mechanics: pay mix, rates, accelerators, ramps, and SPIFs
Partner with GTM Ops on quota setting, capacity, and territory alignment so targets, coverage, and plans fit together each planning cycle
Partner with Finance to model plan cost, attainment scenarios, and earnings distribution, and to keep comp within budget
 Comp operations and payouts
Run the commissions cycle end to end: crediting, calculations, review, approvals, and payout
Partner very closely with Payroll on payout files, timing, and reconciliation so commissions and SPIFs are paid accurately and on schedule
Own plan documents, participant acknowledgments, and the comp calendar
Communicate plans and changes to the field clearly and simply, and be the go-to resource for comp questions
Run a consistent process for inquiries, disputes, and exceptions, and flag recurring exceptions as plan-design issues rather than one-off fixes
 Systems, reporting, and compliance
Build and own our comp systems, including selecting, implementing, and administering a commission platform integrated with Salesforce, HRIS, and payroll
Partner with Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering to keep bookings, roster, and crediting data clean and in sync across systems
Build reporting and dashboards on attainment, payout cost, and plan effectiveness for reps, leaders, and Finance
Partner with Accounting on monthly commission accruals, with documentation and controls that hold up to audit
Use AI and automation to remove manual work, such as data validation, discrepancy checks, and payout estimates for reps
 Who you are
3 to 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, GTM or revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on ownership of both plan design and comp operations
Deep understanding of incentive mechanics, including quotas, accelerators, ramps, draws, clawbacks, and SPIFs, across both new business and post-sales roles
Strong Salesforce knowledge, especially how opportunity and booking data flows into commission calculations
Track record partnering with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate, on-time payouts and clean month-end close
Highly analytical, with advanced Excel or Sheets modeling skills; SQL experience is a plus, not required
A natural business partner who builds trust quickly with sales leaders and reps and can explain comp mechanics simply
Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment handling confidential pay data
Thrives in ambiguity with a 0-to-1 mindset, and is energized by building structure, processes, and tools where none exist yet
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI assistants or automation tools to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy
 Nice to have
Experience standing up a comp function or commission platform at a fast-growing, early-stage SaaS or AI company
Experience with HRIS and payroll integrations, and with multi-country or international comp plans
 Location
 NYC preferred; remote or other locations (SF, Boston, London) considered. This role is for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
 Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
 About The Sales Operations Team
 The Sales Operations team helps Thumbtack’s sales and account management teams grow revenue. We build the programs and tools that help reps bring local service businesses onto Thumbtack and grow strategic existing accounts. The work spans acquisition and account management, with close partners in Product, Marketing, Data Science, Enablement, and QA.
 About The Role
 You’ll drive Thumbtack’s sales strategy and partner closely with the Sales leadership team to execute it. Your focus is growing sales revenue by bringing more pros onto Thumbtack and expanding relationships with existing accounts.
Reporting to the Vice President of Commercial Operations, you’ll lead analysts and managers across North America and the Philippines. There’s room to build new approaches to outbound prospecting, account expansion, and the use of AI in sales. You’ll get close to the data and frontline work yourself, then turn what you learn into programs and strategic levers that’ll deliver impact.
 What You’ll Do
Drive the sales strategy to grow revenue, partnering closely with Sales leadership to set priorities and execute against shared goals.
Build new approaches to outbound acquisition and existing account expansion. Test them in the field and scale what works.
Get into the data and spend time with reps and pros to understand where there’s opportunities to maximize sales and pro lifetime value. Turn those findings into changes that improve conversion and account growth.
Use AI to build better prospecting, selling, and account management workflows. Measure whether reps use them and whether they increase revenue or productivity.
Get agreement on priorities and ownership with Product, Marketing, Data Science, and sales technology partners. Resolve dependencies that hold up execution.
Keep core sales operations running well, including lead routing, account management workflows, and sales tools, so reps can spend more time selling.
Develop the managers on your team and give them clear ownership. Make hiring and performance decisions that build the team’s ability to deliver.
 In order to be successful, you must bring
Experience developing and executing sales or commercial strategy, with clear evidence of revenue growth. High-volume sales to small businesses is especially relevant; management consulting experience is a plus.
The analytical depth to investigate a problem yourself. You question metric definitions, check the underlying data, and test whether your diagnosis holds up.
Experience building a new sales motion, team, or operating capability from an unclear starting point. You’ve done the work to get it adopted and can show what impact that created.
Experience leading managers and developing people. You set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and make difficult decisions when the team needs them.
Clear communication and sound judgment with partners. You can challenge a senior stakeholder’s assumptions with data and evidence, understand your partner’s differing view and drive impact with speed.
Curiosity and urgency. You learn unfamiliar areas quickly and are willing to try a different approach. You can make a call with imperfect information and adjust as you learn.

Bring public sector signal sources, including procurement activity, grant awards, and audit and compliance data, into the scoring models and test whether each one predicts conversion
Define and enforce account and contact data standards for prospect and target accounts, driving remediation with GTM Systems rather than stopping at the report
Analyze win rate, sales cycle, churn, and expansion patterns by segment and vertical to sharpen the ICP and translate findings into targeting rules the field can execute
Own competitive intelligence across segments and solutions, including win/loss patterns and FOIA-sourced commercial insight
Partner with Sales, BD, and Marketing to operationalize scoring and segmentation into territory views, prioritized target lists, and outbound workflows

You bring strong Salesforce capability, including reporting and a working understanding of the account, contact, and opportunity data model
You are fluent in advanced Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with large, messy, multi-source datasets
You can explain a model's logic, its limits, and its results clearly to non-technical sellers and leaders

Familiarity with public sector procurement cycles, budget data, or the GovTech market
Experience managing enrichment or intent data vendor relationships, including ingestion logic and refresh cadence

Practical use of AI tooling for research, enrichment, or unstructured data analysis

Working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, and executive stakeholders, you will turn complex data into actionable recommendations. Own the analytical infrastructure supporting the commercial lifecycle, including data models, metric definitions, source-of-truth logic, transformations, and dashboard architecture.
Develop reliable reporting and performance analysis covering pipeline coverage, stage conversion, win rates, deal size, sales cycle, forecast accuracy, retention, renewal risk, and partner contribution.
Build analytical views across regions, segments, products, sales channels, owners, partners, opportunity types, and customer cohorts to identify trends and explain performance drivers.
Establish data-quality monitoring, reconciliation, and reporting controls across Salesforce, Clari, and related systems to ensure accurate and trusted information.
Translate pipeline, forecast, and renewal data into clear business narratives, highlighting risks, opportunities, and recommended management actions.
Design, build, and maintain production-ready AI-powered workflows for opportunity hygiene, deal-risk detection, forecast commentary, meeting intelligence, next-step quality, renewal preparation, churn signals, expansion opportunities, and management reporting.
Integrate AI capabilities with Salesforce, Clari, Clari Copilot, and structured commercial data through low-code tools, APIs, integrations, and agent-based platforms.
Define prompts, structured outputs, evaluation criteria, exception handling, human oversight, and monitoring to ensure AI workflows are accurate, responsible, and effective.
Apply appropriate governance for data security, access permissions, transparency, and responsible AI use while continuously improving workflow performance and adoption.
Identify high-value automation opportunities and measure their impact on forecast accuracy, seller capacity, sales-cycle efficiency, and retention visibility.
Own the Salesforce opportunity lifecycle from creation through qualification, progression, and close, maintaining stages, entry and exit criteria, required fields, validation rules, and data-hygiene standards.
Lead the forecasting operating model, including cadence, reporting hierarchy, forecast categories, inspection views, submissions, governance, and accuracy measurement.
Administer and optimize Clari and its Salesforce integration, ensuring accurate access, roll-ups, workflows, and reporting.
Use Clari and Clari Copilot insights to identify deal movement, slippage, risks, upside, stakeholder coverage, and coaching opportunities for sales leaders and representatives.
Partner with Sales leadership to strengthen pipeline discipline and execution through process improvements, enablement, regular inspection, and data-driven interventions.
Own the closed-won handoff to Implementation and Customer Success, ensuring appropriate context, ownership, service levels, milestone tracking, and exception management.
Design and maintain scalable renewal processes covering record creation, ownership, timelines, stages, risk assessment, forecast categories, escalation, retention outcome

Role Overview
 The Sales Compensation Business Partner, MXRM is the dedicated compensation partner for approximately 500 MXRM GTM professionals globally, spanning Specialized Sales, Pre-Sales / PDEs, Services sellers, sales management, and partner/channel roles. The role brings focused ownership to work currently split between the Head of MXRM GRO and in-zone GTM Operations teams without dedicated compensation expertise.
The role is the single point of accountability inside MXRM across the compensation year—from quota setting through plan rollout, seller questions, mid-year changes, reporting and year-end payout queries. It connects field needs with the central DISW compensation function, resolving what can be handled locally and escalating clear, well-framed cases when needed.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Influence comes from compensation expertise, sound judgment and credibility with sellers, country managers and the central compensation team. The position is designed as a full-year role: October–January quota setting is the peak cycle, supported by year-round governance, analytics, enablement and plan-effectiveness work.
 Key Responsibilities
 Quota Setting Process (October–January)
Own the end-to-end MXRM quota-setting process for Pre-Sales / PDEs, Services sellers, Specialized Sales and sales management. Partner with Country Managers, who set individual seller quotas, to validate country-level coverage against targets, reconcile aggregates, issue PCTs on time and ensure sellers have signed plans before the fiscal year opens. This is the role’s highest-value and highest-visibility annual deliverable.
 Compensation Plan Rollout & Enablement
Lead the field-facing annual plan rollout: translate approved designs into clear communications, deliver enablement by role and zone, publish supporting materials and help the organization understand plan mechanics before payouts begin. When plans change, explain both what is changing and why.
 Voice of MXRM in Compensation Strategy
Represent MXRM in compensation-design discussions with the central DISW Compensation team, bringing the Specialized Sales perspective upstream rather than after plans are finalized. Make evidence-based cases where corporate defaults do not fit MXRM’s GTM motions, including ARR / NRR priorities, Land-to-Expand and a high-velocity funnel; document MXRM requests and track outcomes.
 First Line of Defence — Seller Compensation Queries
Serve as the single MXRM point of contact for questions about payouts, deal credit and plan-rule application. Resolve issues locally where possible; escalate structured, well-framed cases to the central team when necessary. Provide a dependable support path for sellers while reducing avoidable load on the Head of MXRM GRO, in-zone Operations and central Compensation.
 Governance of Mid-Year Seller Changes
Govern compensation-related handling of role moves, territory splits, transfers, hires and leavers. Ensure account-team membership, LAER crediting setup and SAP Commissions configuration are updated so transactions can be credited correctly. Establish systemic data-hygiene controls and return actionable fixes to field owners; this is not transaction-by-transaction policing.
 Compensation Performance Reporting
Deliver a standing monthly / quarterly compensation view for MXRM leadership, covering payout analytics, attainment distribution, outliers, potential under- or overpayment flags, and FSO consolidation and submission to central compensation administrators. Build a concise management view and respond to material Country Manager requests.
 Compensation Plan Effectiveness Analysis
Evaluate whether plan mechanics and incentives drove intended behavior. Identify gaming patterns and areas where rewards may not align with desired outcomes; provide a credible evidence base for the next fiscal-year plan-design cycle and the role’s MXRM advocacy.
 SPIF / Incentive Program Design & Tracking
Design, track and close out MXRM-focused SPIFs, accelerators and contests tied to specific commercial objectives. Partner with central Compensation on structure and compliance; own MXRM execution, commun
[...]
uding attainment, coverage, pipeline-versus-quota and account-team / LAER data-hygiene checks.
Working fluency in sales-plan mechanics, including quota crediting, splits, accelerators, draws, clawbacks, SPIFs and FSO handling.
Sound judgment and the ability to say “no” with empathy: listen to seller concerns, explain decisions clearly and remain firm without becoming confrontational.
Strong written communication, including the ability to explain a complex plan rule in clear, practical language.
Comfort working across a matrix of field leadership, Country Managers, central Compensation and Finance.
Fluent English.
 Nice to Have
Finance background, including the ability to read a budget, reconcile coverage math and understand the P&L implications of compensation decisions.
Exposure to SAP Commissions or an equivalent sales performance management platform such as Varicent, Xactly or CaptivateIQ.
Experience in a large, matrixed corporate organization and familiarity with central-team operating models.
Prior involvement in compensation-plan design, not only administration or execution.

 About Zen Educate
 Zen Educate is a technology company that matches schools with temporary educator staff. Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over $9bn a year on temporary educators, with over $2bn per year of that spent on fees that take money out of the education system. By leveraging the latest technology, we purpose built a platform that helps schools to pay less while educators earn more.
We want students to have access to the best education possible, and we go the extra mile to find, onboard, match, and coach incredible educators that deeply care about their students. We wake up every day on a mission to care more. We care more about our schools. And we care more about our educators.
We have recently raised our Series B funding of $37mil, the largest round in European EdTech last year. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference and be part of a high growth start-up that is expanding rapidly in the UK and US markets!
 Why this role exists
 Zen Educate places educators in K-12 schools across :20 US regions. Behind every new partnership sits operational work that has to be done right: RFP submissions with tight deadlines and long compliance checklists, hectic conference seasons with significant logistical and planning requirements, nuanced district contracting processes that need to be managed with care and attention.
As Zen has grown, so has the volume of this work, and we're investing in RevOps capacity to match. That gives us room to run each process well and to keep raising the bar on it: every RFP, conference and contract is a chance to make the next one faster and more automated while holding the same standard of polish and accuracy.
This role takes ownership of the critical operational tasks RevOps supports today, and is accountable for how each one turns out. You'll learn each process by running it yourself, which is how you'll see where it breaks and which steps can be automated. Then you'll build those automations, so the work gets faster and more reliable each cycle and frees you to take on the next area. RFPs, conferences and deal desk are where you start. As those run well, the role grows into other parts of RevOps where the same approach pays off.
 What You'll Own
 Your first priorities are below. Each one has a direct line to how quickly Zen signs and launches new partnerships, and they're where RevOps support is most stretched today. Expect the list to change as your automations take work off your plate and new areas need an owner.
 RFP submission coordination. You'll own Zen's RFP process from the moment a bid is identified through submission, and early on it will take the largest share of your time. That means understanding what each district is asking for and what it takes to be compliant, building responses from our existing content, and bringing in subject matter experts across sales, operations, compliance and finance where a question needs something new. You set the plan, keep contributors on it, and make sure what goes out is complete and compelling. The quality of what goes out decides whether we win, so each bid should leave our content library and process in better shape for the next one.
 Conference and event coordination . Our sales team attends state and national education conferences throughout the year, and they're some of the best chances reps get to meet district decision makers in person. Once an event is on the calendar, you own setting the team up to make the most of it. That covers logistics (registration, booth and sponsorship, shipping, travel, spend against the events budget) and the work around them: pulling attendee lists, supporting the coordination and planning of tertiary events around the conference, collaborating with marketing sponsorships that put us in front of the right people, and making sure every key progress with conference attendees is logged in Hubspot following the event.

About Wolt
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
 About The Role
 Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. Drive is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into one EMEA business , with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.
A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next Manager, Strategy & Operations for Grocery & Retail Drive.
You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.
 What You'll Be Doing
Own the Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.
Set the commercial framework for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.
Act as the voice of grocery and retail partners towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.
Run performance management for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
Shape how Drive works with our Marketplace grocery & retail teams, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
Turn wins into playbooks that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.
 Our humble expectations
5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevate you - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.
 Seen as a strong advantage:
Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.
 Why you'll love it
🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands
🛒 A segment to own: Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap
🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales
💪 Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference
💙 Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people
 Next steps
 If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Intelligently Moving Your World 
 XPENG is a leading technology company focused on designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing intelligent mobility solutions, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. We aim to create a thoughtful and empathetic future for mobility that enhances driving experience. Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, XPENG has regional offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Silicon Valley, and San Diego, and in 2021, we established our European headquarters in Amsterdam, along with offices in Copenhagen, Munich, Oslo, and Stockholm.
Our passionate and diverse team, with expertise in technology, finance, and the automotive industry, spans hubs in China, the US, and Europe. Together, we are forging our international presence as pioneers in the future of mobility.
 Why should you be part of our success story? 
 XPENG Inc.'s American Depositary Shares (ADSs) have been listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol 'XPEV' since August 27, 2020, and on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (SEHK) under the symbol '9868.HK' since July 7, 2021. In 2023, XPENG further strengthened its growth trajectory with a $724 million strategic investment from Volkswagen, solidifying its position in the global market. There has never been a more exciting time to join XPENG — a leader in smart electric vehicles and sustainable mobility solutions.
 About XPENG and Belgium expansion 
XPENG is a young technology company building smart electric vehicles and shaping the future of AI mobility. We started with a small team and big ideas, and we still keep that explorer mindset today. We move fast, we challenge convention, and we turn ambitious technology into real world customer experience. Because our Belux business is growing strongly, we are expanding our activities and opening a new office in Mechelen, Belgium. If you want a role where you can build, learn, and have visible impact, you will feel at home here.
 Sales Operations Specialist - Belux 
 The role in a nutshell 
You keep fleet sales running smoothly behind the scenes. You make sure orders are clean, systems are correct, and partners get quick answers. You are the link between leasing partners, retail partners, and internal teams, ensuring that the order journey moves without friction from contract to registration to delivery readiness. When the pace increases, you bring structure and calm.
 What you will focus on in the first 90 days 
Learn our fleet order flow end to end including systems, partner touchpoints, and approval steps
Bring order hygiene to a high standard by tightening validation and documentation routines
Build a reliable cadence with leasing partners and stores for questions, exceptions, and status updates
Create a clear view on stock allocation logic and reduce manual rework and delays
 What you will do 
Receive and validate incoming fleet orders and contracts from leasing partners, stores or agents, and internal stakeholders
Check completeness and accuracy of contract terms, vehicle specifications, billing details, and delivery information
Enter orders into internal systems such as Scepter and ensure correct triggers for logistics and delivery workflows
Allocate available stock vehicles to incoming orders in coordination with planning and logistics
Monitor order progress from entry to delivery readiness and proactively resolve issues or delays

We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line.
At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients.
You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue.
 You Will Be Responsible For
Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth.
Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results.
Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue.
Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground.
Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap.
Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently.
Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention.
Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role.
Commercial performance & optimisation: Track and drive adoption, revenue and margin across markets, using data and customer insight to optimise pricing, packaging and the sales funnel.
Stripe partnership: Manage Treatwell's strategic partnership with Stripe, acting as the senior commercial point of contact and aligning joint go-to-market plans and growth priorities.
 About You
Proven experience in go-to-market, commercial strategy or sales strategy roles within a fast-growing digital or tech company (marketplaces, SaaS, delivery, fintech or similar)
Strong commercial focus, with a track record of owning revenue targets and driving measurable growth
Multi-market experience is a must: you've worked closely with sales teams and sales leadership across multiple markets
Experience leading commercial strategy across multiple markets, ideally in a central or group-level role
Strong analytical skills and confidence building business cases, commercial models and senior leadership updates
Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority

 About Treatwell
 We're a team of 800+ people working every day to transform the beauty industry across Europe. We've built the leading salon management software, connected to Europe's number one marketplace, helping thousands of professionals run and grow their business.
 The Numbers Speak For Themselves
Over 95,000 partner salons

 We'll Treat You With

 RECRUITMENT FRAUD
 Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.
How is Unilever tackling this?
Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.
What can I do?
If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.
Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

Ready for a challenge?
 Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.
 About This Role
 Consumer Pricing is one of the most powerful and sensitive levers in our marketplace and logistics. Every fee we set affects conversion, basket size, growth, retention, courier economics and profitability. As GTM Pricing Manager, you will drive the consumer pricing agenda for your portfolio of markets, with one goal, sustainable growth. You will own pricing performance across a set of markets, while being part of a close-knit team of GTM Pricing Managers who share learnings and best practice across the group.
Day to day, you work with country teams on the tactical pricing questions that matter most to them, from delivery fees to service fees and small order fees. Regularly, you step back with the Head of Strategy & GTM and Pricing Director to shape a company-wide pricing strategy, then take it back to your markets and make it real, adapting it to local dynamics, competition and customer behaviour.
You start small, a city, a segment, a test. You prove what works, using rigorous experimentation and clear measurement of impact on orders, customer experience and profitability, and scale it to national level, then across markets. Because your peers cover different markets, you will constantly exchange insights with them, so that a win in one country can quickly become a win in others. You will also work closely with Product, Data & Analytics, Finance, Marketing and Operations.
You will be given real ownership early, and you will be expected to work out how to get things done as you go. This is a role for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, can manage several markets at once, and can influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
 These are some of the key components to the position:
Be the day-to-day pricing partner to country leadership, bringing clear recommendations rather than open questions.
Form hypotheses, test them in a small geography, read the results honestly and scale what works. Balance growth, profitability and strategic goals, and be explicit about the trade-offs.
Turn what you learn in the market into playbooks and proposals that work across all our markets. Take ideas proven in one market and design how they roll out elsewhere, including where local conditions call for a different approach.
Keep a close eye on competitors and consumer trends in online food delivery. 
Find answers in data yourself, build quick dashboards, and use AI tools and agents as a normal part of how you work, while staying accountable for the quality of the answer. 
Write concise, decision-ready documents that senior leaders can understand quickly and act on with confidence.
Partner with Country Directors and market leadership, Product and Technology, Finance, Marketing and Legal counsel, sometimes all on the same project. 
Excited by the intersection of strategic commercial decisions, experimentation, tech, ML and large scale strategic decision-making? This is the team for you!
 What You'll Bring To The Table
Demonstrable experience in commercial strategy, growth function or a related role, ideally in marketplace, e-commerce, delivery or consumer tech. Familiarity with consumer pricing levers such as delivery fees, service fees, small order fees, subscriptions and promotions is a plus.
Commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to build a business case, understand unit economics, and balance growth, profitability and strategic goals while being explicit about the trade-offs.
A hypothesis-driven approach to decision-making, with experience designing tests, reading results and scaling what works. A working understanding of experimentation and causal impact is expected, and you will partner with data scientist for the deep tech
[...]
 At JET, This Is How We Play
 Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable, our customers' choice.
