Revenue Operations at PointClickCare partners directly with the Commercial Leadership Team, spanning Deal Desk, GTM Strategy, Revenue Enablement, and Continuous Improvement, as well as providing quoting, forecasting, analytics, and reporting support. This role sits within that team as the dedicated Rev Ops partner to an assigned Commercial vertical, directly supporting the SVP/General Manager and senior Sales leader, as well as broader Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services teams within the vertical. This role partners closely with cross-functional peers across Finance, Product, and Marketing, and within internal Revenue Operations teams. The Revenue Operations Partners pair deep analytical rigor with hands-on executive support. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape best practices across forecasting and planning, as well as providing hands-on support with complex quoting, opportunity management, and driving efficiencies through AI and automation, to focus on providing strategic insights to the leaders of this vertical. 
 The Sr. Revenue Operations Manager serves as the dedicated partner to an assigned Commercial Leadership Team (CLT) vertical, acting as the primary interface between the GM, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Service leadership with the broader Rev Ops function. This role exists to drive forecasting discipline, business review readiness, annual planning, and data integrity for its aligned segment, while serving as a strategic advisor to the GM and commercial leadership in this vertical on performance, risk, and opportunity. This role also drives continuous improvement in Rev Ops processes, standards, and transparency across the forecast-to-close lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Strategic Business Partnership
Act as the trusted Revenue Operations business partner to an assigned vertical (e.g., Senior Living, Acute & Payer, etc.), serving as a right hand to the GM and Commercial leaders in that vertical by providing day-to-day operational support and strategic counsel, challenging existing thinking, and helping leaders make better decisions and drive execution
Manage the sales forecasting cadence for the aligned segment, ensuring forecasts are current and accurate, and own the quarterly reforecasting process; build a consolidated view of pipeline, bookings, and attainment for leadership and the CRO
Prepare and review weekly/monthly forecast and pipeline reports, proactively following up on deals requiring clarification and providing insight on forecast quality
Support and help drive the leadership team's operating cadence, including weekly business reviews, MBRs/QBRs, and executive leadership meetings (Executive Committee updates, Commercial Leadership Team (CLT) offsites, etc.); develop agendas, executive-ready speaking points, presentations, dashboards, and pre-read materials, while coordinating priorities, tracking decisions, driving follow-through, and ensuring outstanding items are resolved to drive alignment and accountability
Serve as an escalation point for deal/quote related questions, recommending actions on approvals and making decisions within scope, partnering with Deal Desk and Finance on complex deal structuring
Partner with the GM and Commercial leadership to advance key strategic initiatives, coordinating cross-functional efforts, tracking milestones, and helping remove barriers to execution
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance (churn reporting, PS revenue, cost forecasts, etc.) and Resource Management Office (RMO) for PS resourcing and capacity planning to deliver timely insights to Commercial leadership. Analyze business performance across bookings, pipeline, sales productivity, and key commercial KPIs to identify trends, surface risks and opportunities, and recommend actions and influence decisions to improve execution and results
Annual & Strategic Planning
Drive and coordinate the annual planning process for the aligned segment, providing strategic input and partnering with Sales leadership, Finance, HR, and the broader Rev Ops team on the plan, including budgeting, quota setting, territory and account planning, and compensation plan
[...]
Business Partners to ensure consistent, scalable support models across verticals, and share best practices and insights to strengthen the overall team
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication
Act as a connective link between the Commercial teams and FP&A, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, as well as GTM teams
Prepare concise, executive-ready summaries of segment performance, risks, and recommendations for vertical senior leadership
Represent segment perspectives in Rev Ops leadership discussions, and represent Rev Ops priorities and standards back to vertical leadership
Support M&A integration activities as needed, including data, process, and systems alignment
 Qualifications & Skills 
 Minimum Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
8–10 years of relevant business experience, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or technology company
Demonstrated experience managing operations and complex processes, with at least 2+ years in a people leadership or cross-functional partnership capacity
Experience working closely with senior cross-functional executives and leadership teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, decision-ready insight for senior stakeholders
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; strong working knowledge of Salesforce.com
 Preferred Qualifications 
MBA or a Master's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
Experience partnering directly with a CRO or senior Commercial Leadership Team
Experience supporting executive-level decision making
Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes, billing models, and contract structures
SaaS and/or healthcare technology industry experience

Introduction:
As a Sales Operations Manager on our Revenue Operations Team, you are the dedicated operational backbone driving high performance across our global (EMEA/US) Sales team. You own the tools our SDRs and AEs work in, you’ll continuously refine the processes that carry a deal from first touch to close, and the data our leadership forecasts from. You also integrate AI into the sales cycle to take sales efficiency to the next level, making selling faster and smarter at every stage.
What you will be doing:
Sales workflow & continuous enhancement: You own the operational design of the sales lifecycle, from territory and account assignment logic to sales methodology and processes that ensure seamless, effective, scalable handoff from Sales to Client Development.
Sales tech stack: You are the product owner for the tools our SDR and Account Executive teams rely on every day, from Salesforce and Gong to our sales engagement and lead research systems like ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. You partner closely with our Tech team to turn what Sales needs into workable solutions, and you own the path from scoping and prioritization through testing, documentation, and adoption.
Reporting and forecasting: You evolve the reporting infrastructure our team runs on, from the pipeline generation and outreach analytics our SDR and AE teams work in day to day to the forecasting leadership relies on. You turn that data into a clear read on how we are tracking against plan, surfacing the risks and opportunities our sales leadership needs to act on.
AI along the demand & sales process: You bring AI into how we prospect and sell, from proposal creation to deal scoring, identifying where automation can take work off the team's plate and where better signals can sharpen how we sell. You shape these opportunities into concrete solutions together with our Tech team and AI Automation Engineer, and you own their rollout and adoption.
Data integrity: You safeguard the quality of our opportunity and pipeline data, from the input processes upstream to working with the RevOps team to automate the recurring routines that keep records clean.
Collaboration: You coordinate across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and our client-facing teams, keeping everyone aligned on the processes and data you own.
Who you are:
You have 3+ years of hands-on Sales Operations experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
Hands-on with the sales tech stack: You are a genuine Salesforce power-user who builds your own reports and dashboards, and you have owned other parts of the sales tech stack e.g. Gong, ZoomInfo, Salesloft.
Data-driven and analytical: You have a proven ability to build reports and translate complex data into insights people can act on, and you have built or improved forecasting infrastructure.
Fluent with AI and automation: You use AI tools daily for real productivity gains, and you have a good instinct for where automation helps along a sales process and where it does not.
Meticulously detail-orientated: You have a high bar for accuracy and understand that data integrity, clean records, and getting the small things right are what keep everything else running.
An autonomous and curious owner: You are proactive and resourceful, with a "doer" mentality and the ability to take projects from initial scoping to full adoption. You ask why before how, and you are genuinely interested in how systems fit together.
An excellent communicator and collaborator: You articulate complex ideas clearly and can steer stakeholder discussions where interests are not aligned, such as a handover between sales and client-facing teams. You thrive in an open, feedback-driven culture.
Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
Benefits of working at quantilope:
Wellness is key: We offer private health insurance with Vitality, a cash back plan, travel insurance for all your trips as well as regular mental health training, and the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have our quantiwell days which are global mental health days once a quarter where the whole company takes a day for themselves.
Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?
Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with Nest Pension Plan.
Team Bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties, global retreats..where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way. 
Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.
 About Us
 Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI-driven solutions to support data-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300+ brands.
As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.

About Guardey
Guardey is a modern security awareness training platform that helps organisations turn their biggest cyber risk – people – into their first line of defence. With gamified micro-learning (3–5 minutes per week), real-time risk insights and audit-ready reporting, we make it easy for organisations to stay compliant with frameworks such as NIS2, BIO, NEN 7510, ISO and GDPR. We work directly and through partners with organisations ranging from SMBs to strategic accounts, across sectors including education, healthcare, municipalities, safety regions, industry and logistics, and hospitality.
We’re growing fast across new markets, regions and sectors, with the ambition to reach €20M+ ARR. Customers who stay and grow with us are the foundation of that growth. That’s why we’re hiring a Customer Success Manager.
The Role
As Customer Success Manager you own a portfolio of customers and make them successful with Guardey. You are their go-to contact, from kick-off through every renewal. You know your customers, their sector and what NIS2 or the BIO requires of them. You think ahead, spot signals before the customer does, and your customers know they can always count on you. You will be a key player in building Customer Success at Guardey: from a personal approach to a repeatable, scalable way of working.
Key Responsibilities
 Onboarding & implementation 
Guide new customers from kick-off to go-live: setting goals, technical setup, communication to employees and group structure.
Define together with the customer what success looks like, so you work towards it from day one.
 Adoption & advisory 
Monitor participation, scores and phishing behaviour, and step in early when adoption drops.
Run evaluations in which you translate data into concrete advice, including for management and the board.
Act as a sparring partner for customers on compliance, such as NIS2, BIO and NEN 7510.
 Renewals & growth 
Prepare renewals with a story that shows the value Guardey has delivered.
Recognise growth opportunities based on the customer’s needs, such as a new storyline, an extra module or board training and propose what genuinely fits.
 Escalations & customer relationships 
Take the lead when something goes wrong: align internally with Support and Product and keep the customer informed until it’s resolved.
Monitor the health of your portfolio and flag risks before a customer churns.
 Cross-functional collaboration 
Help shape how we set up Customer Success, from the playbook to smarter processes in HubSpot.
Share structured feedback from customers and end users with Product and Content.
Work closely with Sales, Support and the partner team to ensure smooth handovers and a great customer experience.
What You Bring
 Experience & background 
At least 3 years of relevant work experience in a customer-facing role, such as Customer Success, Account Management, Implementation or Consultancy, ideally in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity or IT.
Experience managing your own portfolio and guiding renewals.
Experience with HubSpot, with education, healthcare or the public sector, or with international customers is a plus.
 Skills & mindset 
 Proactive & ownership: you come to a customer with a plan, not a question, and you follow through on what you start.

 Empathy & relationship building: you understand what’s going on at a customer and dare to be honest about what they really need.
 Interest in security & compliance: you don’t need to be a NIS2 expert, but you want to become one.
 Structured communicator: you switch easily between an IT administrator and a board member, in Dutch and English.
What We Offer
Real influence: you help build a small CS team that is very much in motion.
A role with impact: your work directly contributes to Guardey’s journey towards €20M+ ARR.
An entrepreneurial team with short lines of communication and lots of room for ownership.

Interested?

About us 
Crunchr is the people analytics platform for forward-thinking HR teams. We believe people are the key to a company's value, so we start with our own.
We're a lean team working from Amsterdam (headquarters), London, and Boston: genuinely curious, open-minded, and down to earth. We share what we know, stay open to better ideas, and let data, not ego, guide our decisions. For more information about us, you can visit the Crunchr careers page.
 Some context about the role 
As GTM Engineer at Crunchr you sit between our commercial team and our GTM technology & data. You turn the way our sales, BDR and marketing teams want to work into working systems: automations, integrations and AI-powered tools that remove manual work and help the team spend their time on customers (to be). You own the technical side and data hygiene of our go-to-market stack, with HubSpot at the centre.
Some of your responsibilities will be:
Build AI and technology-led solutions: Design and ship solutions with AI (Claude projects, skills, agents, Claude Code or similar) and our current toolstack to support the commercial team, from account research and call preparation to automated enablement processes.
Automate outbound: Build and run automated outbound flows for the BDR function, covering intent sources, enrichment, triggers, personalisation, sequencing and routing, supporting our BDRs. Measure what works and iterate.
Own GTM data and integrations: Ensure hygiene across HubSpot and connected platforms and build reliable connections between our GTM tools so data flows once and reporting can be trusted.
Support Marketing: Partner with Marketing on Demand Generation insights, lead scoring, attribution and creative, AI-driven campaigns that generate leads and awareness.
Report, document and enable: Maintain GTM dashboards, document what you build, and train the team so new tooling is actually adopted.
Evaluate tooling: Scout, test and recommend new GTM and AI tooling, and manage the technical side of vendor relationships for the GTM stack.
 Requirements 
2+ years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, sales operations or a comparable role in a fast-moving (B2B SaaS) environment.
Hands-on HubSpot experience is a must: workflows, properties, sequences, reporting, integrations.
Strong experience with the wider GTM toolstack (enrichment, outbound, conversational intelligence, automation platforms).
Proven track record of building solutions with AI that bring the GTM toolstack together; you can show what you built and what it changed.
Comfortable working with AI coding assistants (Claude Code/VS Code or similar) to build and maintain automations; formal coding experience is not required, but you need to be able to read, debug and reason about what these tools produce.
Structured and data-minded: you care about clean data, you document your work and you measure outcomes.
Strong communication skills: you can translate a vague request from Sales into a scoped solution and explain the result back in plain language.
Fluent in English.
 Nice to have 
Experience with Apollo, Jiminny (or Gong), Google Analytics.
Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, SQL or Python.
Experience supporting an outbound BDR team directly.
Familiarity with a sales methodology such as SPICED.
 What you can expect from us 
A great place to start your career: an individual learning budget, regular hackathons and focus days for your development, and colleagues who genuinely want to see you succeed.
Autonomy, trust, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact on Crunchr's growth story.
4 weeks of workation, floating holidays, an annual company trip and local meetups.
Healthy lunches together at our Amsterdam office, with a view of the city skyline.

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Location: Fredericton, NB or Moncton, NB or Halifax, NS
Hybrid: 4 days onsite
 About The Role
 We’ve moved Marketing at Bulletproof from counting activity to driving conversions. Now we need someone who can prove it. This role is the connective tissue between Marketing and Sales. You’ll own the revenue funnel end to end: how accounts get scored, how leads get routed, how we attribute pipeline, and how we report it. When you’re done, Sales and Marketing look at the same numbers and trust them.
This is not a “build a dashboard and walk away” job. One day you’re digging into Salesforce to fix a lead source mapping or merge a pile of duplicate contacts. The next day you’re in front of the executive team explaining what’s converting, what isn’t, and what we should do about it. You know how a B2B deal moves from first touch to closed-won, and you know how every system, field and workflow either helps it along or gets in the way.
If you like clean data, hard questions, and being the person in the room with the answer, keep reading.
 Job Responsibilities
 Funnel Strategy & Alignment
Define and run our shared funnel metrics and stage definitions, from MQL → SAL → SQL → Opportunity → Closed-Won.
Work with Sales and Marketing leadership to put our ICP, ABM tiers, territory alignment and scoring models into practice.
Build and enforce follow-up SLAs so good leads and accounts don’t go cold.
Systems Administration & Integration
Own the integrations, sync rules and field mappings that keep leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns and opportunities flowing correctly between systems: Salesforce, HubSpot, Demandbase, ZoomInfo and Outreach
Handle the day-to-day: troubleshooting, and building or updating fields, objects, forms, workflows and automations.
Partner with Sales Ops and IT to keep the stack governed, secure and ready to scale.
Data Integrity & Cleanup
Own data quality across the full pipeline. That means dedupes, Lead/Contact merges, account hierarchies, and clean, standardized lead source and channel values.
Lead the cleanup projects that fix attribution at the root, including lead source remediation and legacy campaign cleanup.
Check every import and list load before it touches the system.
Audit regularly, and put rules in place that stop bad data at the door.
Document how everything works: processes, definitions, record types, fields, workflows, reports and dashboards.
Analytics, Dashboards & Reporting
Build executive dashboards in Salesforce, HubSpot and Demandbase that show account engagement, pipeline creation and influence, and revenue contribution.
Build and maintain the attribution and ROI reporting that shows exactly what Marketing contributes to pipeline and revenue.
Deliver weekly and monthly scorecards on funnel health, campaign ROI, ABM progress and BD/AE performance.
Find the trends in conversion rates and cohort performance, then turn them into clear recommendations for leadership, BD and AEs. We want answers, not just charts.
Partner with Finance on marketing ROI and with the ELT on how we report.
ABM & Campaign Intelligence
Run Demandbase, including account lists, intent signals, engagement scoring and AE territory alignment.
Bring account prioritization and intent insights to our territory pod syncs and joint account planning sessions.
Build the orchestration workflows that connect Sales, BD and Marketing on ABM campaigns.
Make sure every campaign is tagged, tracked, measurable and tied to Sales priorities.
Enablement & Cross-Functional Partnership
Train Sales and BD on our dashboards, playbooks, CRM best practices and campaign insights.
Be the bridge between Marketing and Sales on targeting, pipeline and revenue goals.
Champion measurement. No vanity metrics, only revenue outcomes.
Use AI, including Microsoft Copilot, to move faster on analysis, reporting and documentation.
Other duties as assigned.
What You’ll Bring
5+ years in Marketing Ops, Sales Ops or RevOps in a B2B environment.
3+ years of hands-on CRM and marketing automation administration, including integrations, field mapping and workflow automation.
Admin- or super-user-level skills in Salesforce and HubSpot. Sales
[...]
ensive travel medical coverage
Professional certification reimbursement for relevant career development
Mental Health Counselling and Family Assistance Program
Community involvement and volunteer opportunities
Give back while getting paid with dedicated volunteer time
Competitive Extended health care benefits ($1500 per year massage therapy coverage)
Goodlife Fitness corporate rate – It’s 25% off memberships
Recognition and rewards, including score-card performance bonus, and service award bonus
 About Bulletproof
 At Bulletproof, we help organizations stay secure, compliant, and future-ready through Microsoft-powered technology solutions and managed services. For more than 20 years, we've partnered with public sector organizations, regulated industries, and commercial businesses across North America to reduce risk, modernize operations, and drive measurable outcomes. As a trusted Microsoft solutions partner, we combine deep expertise in cybersecurity, cloud, compliance, and managed services with a people-first culture that values growth, innovation, and meaningful impact.
 Equal Opportunity Statement
 Bulletproof is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Bulletproof is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

The role & impact
 As the Head of Sales Operations for UK, EMEA, and South Africa, you are the strategic engine powering our Go-To-Market (GTM) operations across Xero and Melio teams. Acting as a strategic partner to regional sales leadership and the Regional Strategy and Operations function, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and field execution. By shaping global programs to fit regional needs, you ensure that regional growth becomes a predictable outcome rather than just a goal.
Serving as our regional voice of truth, you will provide objective, data-backed insights that help Managing Directors and sales leaders anticipate trends, make informed commercial decisions, and guide seller behaviour. You will design a resilient sales operating system that supports our transition into complex, multi-product partner engagements, ultimately helping small businesses thrive through better technology.
 The Team & How They Connect
 You will lead and mentor a dedicated Sales Operations team, fostering a collaborative environment focused on accountability and continuous improvement. Your group sits at the intersection of the business, acting as the vital link between regional sales teams, finance, marketing, technology, and our Global Sales Operations Centres of Excellence. Together, you work with a unified mindset to align regional priorities, clear roadblocks for field teams, and turn data into clear commercial strategies.
 The team is currently working on 
 Maintaining Salesforce as our single source of truth while leveraging Tableau, Snowflake, dbt, and AI performance tools to automate reporting and deliver real-time pipeline visibility.
Governing the regional Rhythm of the Business through structured Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, alongside leading the regional forecasting cadence with finance and sales leaders.
Optimising regional coverage models, territory strategies, and sales incentives—including targets, SPIFs, and rebates—to align seller capacity with regional growth goals.
Partnering with Global Sales Innovation teams to trial and scale new AI agents and automation tools, while evolving sales readiness for complex, multi-product engagements.
 Where And How You Can Work
 This is a remote role supporting our teams across the UK, EMEA, and South Africa. While your day-to-day work can be done remotely, you will also have opportunities for meaningful in-person collaboration alongside your regional colleagues and leadership teams when needed.
 Here are some of the things we are looking for
You bring proven leadership experience within Sales or Revenue Operations in a fast-paced SaaS, fintech, or accounting environment, having successfully guided teams through high growth or business model shifts.
Your background includes managing complex Go-To-Market architectures, such as overseeing multiple Salesforce instances and shifting operations from single-product to multi-product sales.
A deep understanding of the SaaS revenue model—including LTV, CAC, and churn—enables you to connect daily operational metrics directly to broader financial outcomes.
Technical fluency in Salesforce workflows and business intelligence tools like Tableau, Snowflake, and dbt allows you to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Strong relationship-building skills help you act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, offering objective, data-led perspectives even when navigating challenging performance realities.
Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

About CERRIX 
CERRIX is a European GRC platform built for banks, insurers and pension funds. It replaces manual, fragmented risk processes with one structured, integrated environment. Founded in the Netherlands in 2014, CERRIX focuses on real operational risk management, in line with regulation such as DNB, AFM and DORA. Since acquiring Ruler, CERRIX connects regulatory change directly to risk management: from monitoring the regulatory landscape to structuring risk assessments, controls, audits and reporting. Powered by AI, the platform automates routine work, so risk professionals can focus on judgement, collaboration and strategic decisions. More than 200 organisations in over 20 countries trust CERRIX and Ruler, which is purpose-built for financial institutions in Europe.
 Why this role 
Our Customer Success team manages our customer portfolio and makes sure every customer gets consistent value from our GRC and regulatory solutions, CERRIX and Ruler. Our largest customers each have a dedicated Customer Success Manager. Most of our customers, however, are better served in a different way: through programmes, campaigns, good content and smart automation. That is where this new role comes in.
 What you will do 
As Scaled Customer Success Manager, you design and run scalable customer success programmes, such as onboarding journeys, lifecycle touchpoints, webinars and digital campaigns, to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. Day to day, you analyse customer usage data, spot risks and growth opportunities, and reach out to customers proactively to support retention and expansion. In practice, you:
 Are the point of contact for a broad group of customers. You follow how they use the platform, spot early when something is off and step in where needed.
 Build and run scalable programmes. Think onboarding journeys, email campaigns, webinars, product updates and help articles. You measure what works and improve it, together with Marketing.
 Manage the contract renewals in your portfolio. You make sure they are prepared on time and that customers know where they stand.
 Spot growth opportunities. You see when a customer would benefit from extra modules, a different licence model or our other product line, and you work out the opportunity with Sales.
 Streamline support and operations. You coordinate first-line support, keep customer data and processes in order, and find what we can automate, including with AI.
 Help the whole team. You make sure your colleagues get the right information about their customers on time, such as upcoming renewals and risk signals.
You work closely with your CS colleagues, Sales, Marketing, Professional Services and Product to act on customer feedback, refine best practices and keep improving the customer experience.
 Who you are

We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙
 The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.
We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.
We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

 Reports to: CRO / VP Revenue (interim CEO)
 Level: IC4, permanent, full-time
 Salary: £60-80k per annum (negotiable)
 Applications close: 15 December 2026
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own the data foundation, forecasting and operating rhythm of our entire revenue engine, from first marketing touch through pipeline, close, onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion. This is not a reporting role. You will treat data as a means to a decision, building the structures, models and cadences that tell leadership where revenue will come from, where it is at risk, what capacity we need to deliver it and what to do next. You will operate as a scale-up builder, not a big-company administrator: AI-native (fluent with tools such as Claude), automation first and narrative before numbers. This is one of the most visible roles in the business: you will be the voice of our numbers, preparing and presenting at leadership meetings, the Executive Committee and the Board, and keeping the whole company informed on how we are performing.
Climate X is a climate risk analytics company that turns physical climate risk into figures banks can lend against. We are a Certified B Corp with offices in London and New York, preparing for our Series B.
Our principle: decisions, not dashboards
 Every metric has an owner and a decision attached. If nobody would act differently because of a number, we aren't tracking or communicating the right thing.
 One version of the truth. Definitions are agreed once and used everywhere, from the board pack to pipeline coverage planning.
 Leading over lagging. Signals that predict revenue matter more than reports that explain last quarter.
 Insight is delivered, not discovered. Automated reporting and Slack-based queries put trusted answers in front of the right owner at the moment it matters. Nothing should ever be a surprise to the Business.
What you will own
 A golden source of truth. Build on our existing software stack (HubSpot, Outreach, Clay, Airspeed, etc) foundations to evolve and govern the end-to-end GTM data model (accounts, leads, opportunities, contracts, renewals, usage and health), lifecycle and stage definitions with clear entry/exit criteria, data quality, account hierarchies and a documented metrics dictionary. Make the data warehouse the golden source for every number we report, integrating CRM, marketing, platform usage and billing data, and make it queryable by anyone in plain English via Slack and AI tools such as Claude.
 Forecasting. Own the forecast across new business, renewals and expansion across our direct and indirect (partnerships) channels. Blend rep commit, historical conversion and signal-based or AI-assisted models; publish forecast accuracy; model ARR, NRR, GRR and churn; reconcile with Finance and run scenarios for the board.
 Lead generation (Marketing and OpGen). Top-of-funnel performance across Marketing and OpGen (SDR/BDR) activity: lead and meeting volume, quality and conversion to qualified pipeline by channel, campaign, segment, sector and region; attribution and campaign ROI; and a data-driven ICP.
 Sales pipeline (AEs). The AE-owned pipeline from qualified opportunity to close: conversion, velocity and value by stage; pipeline coverage targets; automated alerts on stalled or single-threaded deals; deal inspection for forecast calls; and win/loss analysis.
 Post-sale lifecycle (CS and Account Management). Onboarding, time to value, adoption and usage; a validated customer health score; the renewals forecast and expansion pipeline; and feedback into targeting so we win more of our best-fit customers.
 Capacity and GTM planning. Targets, quotas, territories and compensation mechanics; translate the revenue plan into required capacity across OpGen, AEs, Solutions, onboarding and Customer Success, using ramp, productivity and hiring lead-time assumptions.
 Systems, automation and operating rhythm. Own and rationalise the GTM stack; fully automate routing, handoffs and recurring reporting so nobody builds a report by hand; run the weekly, monthly and quarterly revenue cadenc
[...]
 Claude to analyse, automate and build internal tools (using AI-assisted code); experience making trusted data self-serve through tools like Slack.
 Benchmarks and intuition. Deep knowledge of enterprise SaaS and AI go-to-market benchmarks, and what investors and Boards expect at Series A to C (win rates, sales cycles, pipeline coverage, NRR, CAC payback, sales efficiency) and a strong instinct for what is working and what is not, including when the data says something the benchmark does not.
 Board-level presence. You have prepared and presented performance narratives to executive teams and Boards, and you challenge senior leaders with evidence.
 Nice to have. Experience in an AI or data-platform company; product-usage data in a platform or API business; standing up a right-sized data warehouse that joins CRM, billing and usage data, and connecting AI tools to it.
Hiring process
Three stages, about two weeks from first call to offer: (1) a 45-minute intro interview with the CRO / VP Revenue; (2) a 2-hour take-home technical challenge, followed by a 45-minute review with the CRO and Finance; (3) a 45-minute final interview with the interim CEO and one cross-functional leader, with references afterwards. AI supports our process; a person makes every decision.
How to apply
Click the Apply button on this page to send us your application.
Questions about the role or the process? Email careers@climate-x.com with “Senior Revenue Operations Manager” in the subject line.
Climate X is an equal opportunity employer. We select on merit against the skills the role requires.

Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform.
Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior.
Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine.
 ABOUT THE ROLE: 
Talon.One is seeking an experienced Senior Customer Success Operations Manager to support the growth and operational effectiveness of our global Post Sales organization. This role will serve as a dedicated strategic and operational partner to the VP of Customer, working closely with Post Sales leadership to translate organizational priorities into execution, improve team productivity, and drive customer retention and growth. It will focus on driving operational discipline through structured forecasting, performance analytics, and project coordination. You will work closely with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for improvement, establish scalable processes, and provide the insights and operational support needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, you will also contribute to broader RevOps initiatives, ensuring Customer Success priorities remain aligned with Talon.One's commercial strategy.
This is a full-time role based in London.
 ABOUT THE TEAM: 
You will be joining our Revenue Operations team, a central pillar of Talon.One's global go-to-market strategy. They serve as strategic partners to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership, ensuring our revenue engine is scalable, data-driven, and aligned across regions. As a cross-functional team with a global remit, we work collaboratively across time zones to streamline systems, surface insights, and optimize processes across the entire customer journey. Our mission is to empower revenue teams with the tools, data, and workflows they need to drive predictable growth, make smarter decisions, and deliver world-class customer experiences.
 ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL: 
Drive effective Customer Success capacity and account coverage planning, partnering with CS leadership to optimize portfolio assignments, workload distribution, and CSM productivity
Own the retention, renewal, and churn forecasting rhythm, partnering with CS leadership to build visibility into customer health, churn risk, and renewal outcomes through structured account reviews
Analyze customer lifecycle performance to identify drivers of retention, churn, and expansion, and partner with CS leadership on initiatives that improve outcomes and accountability
Define and own the QBR process end to end, including cadence and structure, and support Customer Success Managers in building strong QBR decks and data
Lead program management for the Post Sales team, tracking progress against OKRs, coordinating team-lead meetings, and keeping cross-functional initiatives on track 
Identify operational inefficiencies by partnering closely with CSMs, and translate what you find into scalable processes, working with the Salesforce admin team to bring changes to life
Own the operational framework for the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal management, and segmentation, ensuring consistent execution across Customer Success, Sales, and other functions
 WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE: 
Background in post-sales or customer success operations, whether you moved into ops from a CSM role or have built CS Ops processes directly
6+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations or a closely related post-sales function within a SaaS or technology company, including at least 2 years in a senior role
A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, with the ability to interpret CRM data and clearly translate the process or automation changes you need to a technical admin team
Demonstrated experience owning customer lifecycle management, retention, and renewal forecasting, and customer health measurement
Experience with CS capacity planning, account segmentation, and operational performance reporting
Advanced Excel skills and a strong analytical mindset, ideally including experience preparing QBR data and materials
Excellent communication skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders across functions
 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 
Adyen+, a significant monthly cash benefit to spend on whatever matters most to you and your wellbeing
25 days of paid annual leave 
100% company-paid private health insurance including in-patient, outpatient and psychiatric cover
Retirement plan coverage when you contribute 3% of your base salary, we’ll contribute 7%

Parental leave of up to a year for birthing parents, including 16 weeks at full pay and 10 weeks at half pay, plus 4 weeks of paid leave for non-birthing parents
Daily lunches, limitless coffee and an annual commuting subscription in our London office
Annual all-company gathering at Adyen’s headquarters in Amsterdam, plus regional team events throughout the year
Opportunity to connect in person at Adyen offices across 29 locations worldwide

At Trackunit, we’re on a mission to eliminate downtime in construction. As we scale globally, we’re looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to be the named RevOps lead for our EMEA & APJ Go-to-Market (GTM) organization.
You’ll be the first person Sales and Customer Success leaders come to for anything RevOps, and the right-hand partner to our Senior Director, GTM Operations in the region. This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll solve problems end to end without being told how, work comfortably with high ambiguity, and do the work as well as design it. You’ll also help shape our global RevOps strategy.
You’ll be managed with a light touch. You run your own business within RevOps, with support from your leader and in lock-step with your GTM Operations counterpart in AME.
We offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations in EMEA or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.
 What’s in it for you?
A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450.
A clear path toward leading a RevOps team, with room to coach colleagues and build the function as we lay the foundation.
An international environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.
Support for your personal and professional development through training, coaching and an open feedback culture. We do this by touching on your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams and relations, and impacting the organisation and strategy.
Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need and we’ll make sure you have the IT equipment to do it.
Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This starts with our hiring: we do not discriminate, and we only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.
 Who are you ideally?
7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or Customer Success Operations in B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years in a senior role owning the outcomes of a region, segment or function.
A track record of owning problems end to end. You can describe cases where you found the root cause, fixed it, communicated the result and prevented it from recurring, without direction from a manager.
Senior-level Salesforce knowledge. You build and fix reports and fields yourself for routine changes rather than raising tickets, and you can guide process design alongside Systems Admins.
Executive presence. You communicate clearly and concisely with VP and C-level leaders, in writing and in person, and you hold a position with data.
Proven prioritisation. You can show how you choose between competing demands using team goals, without being told.
Comfort with high ambiguity and with doing the hands-on work yourself, including routine operational tasks.
 Nice to have:
Experience leading or mentoring people, or a strong record of informal leadership.
Experience with Gong or similar forecasting tools.
Experience supporting GTM teams across several EMEA markets.
Experience building or scaling a RevOps function.
Don’t meet every single requirement? This is what we’re looking for ideally, but if you’re particularly drawn to this role and your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply.
 This role is probably not the right fit if you:
prefer to be given a task list and a framework each day
want to advise or design strategy only, without also doing the execution
need frequent check-ins to prioritise or get unblocked
escalate problems rather than resolve them
 Primary responsibilities:
Act as the named RevOps lead for EMEA & APJ. Set priorities against team goals, run the regional backlog, and decide what gets done, delayed or declined, and why.
Represent the Senior Director, GTM Operations in regional strategy, planning and business-review sessions. Prepare o
[...]
jects: scope, plan, track, align stakeholders and deliver.
Carry a full share of the team’s day-to-day operational load without waiting to be assigned each task.
 Our hiring process
 Don’t waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that’s not in the cover letter.
Initial conversation with a colleague from our Talent Acquisition team to get to know each other.
Interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team, including a deeper look at how you work.
Case study. You’ll be given a real-world case to prepare in advance and present to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.
Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!
 Coming Together To Connect Construction
 We’re committed to construction, one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider, but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.
We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products. It’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

Company Description
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
 Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
 For everyone, everywhere.
 Job Description
 More about our mission and what we offer .
You’ll join a lean, global Revenue Operations team and work closely with Wise Business commercial leadership, regional sales teams, Finance, Analytics, Marketing and CRM.
Building on our existing lead management and sales process foundations, your focus will be commercial performance and building a unified end-to-end process:quotas, forecasting, sales productivity, outbound effectiveness, lead management and capacity planning as we expand across regions.
We’re looking for someone who combines strategic judgement with the willingness to get into the details. You’ll spot opportunities before they become requests, prioritise the changes with the greatest potential impact, and bring people together to make them happen.
Your ownership will continue through implementation, adoption and measurement. Success means stronger revenue growth, faster customer activation, more productive sales teams and better commercial decisions - not simply completed projects.
Your mission
Find and unlock growth opportunities. Understand the journey from prospecting and qualification through activation, ongoing usage and revenue. Identify where we lose momentum, quantify the opportunity, and build a focused agenda to improve conversion and accelerate revenue.
Raise the team’s performance and ambition. Partner with regional leaders to set stretching, evidence-based goals and establish clear expectations for performance. Bring constructive challenge to reviews, surface gaps early, and turn discussions into decisions and action. Share what works across regions and help colleagues strengthen their commercial judgement.
Build quotas and capacity plans that support growth. Translate commercial ambitions into plans grounded in market opportunity, sales capacity, rep ramp and productivity. Make clear recommendations on where to invest, how to deploy resources, and which improvements will increase the return on that investment.
Make forecasting a tool for better decisions. Build a forecasting approach that connects pipeline, conversion, activation and revenue. Explain what is driving performance, challenge assumptions, and work with commercial leaders on actions to close gaps and capture upside.
Improve payback and sales productivity. Work with Finance and Analytics to understand the economics of our sales motions. Develop a practical payback playbook that helps leaders decide which segments, channels and approaches to scale, improve or stop.
Turn outbound activity into commercial results. Partner with Marketing, CRM and Sales to develop and test targeted outbound campaigns. Measure performance through to activation and revenue, learn quickly, and scale approaches that demonstrate attractive returns.
Use systems and automation to multiply impact. Work with GTM Tooling & Systems and Analytics to translate commercial needs into effective tools, reporting and workflows. Apply automation and AI where they improve conversion, decision-making or selling capacity, and measure whether those benefits materialise.
 Qualifications
 A bit about you
You have a track record of commercial impact. You bring solid experience in Revenue Operations, Revenue Strategy, Sales Operations or Strategy & Operations, working closely with commercial leaders.
You identify the work that matters. You have examples of spotting an opportunity, building the case for change and driving it forward without waiting for a brief. You are comfortable challenging priorities and recommending what to stop.
You understand high-velocity sales. You know how segmentation, qualification, conversion, rep productivity, activation and customer economics interact in an SMB or B2B sales motion. Experience in a high-growth technology or fintech business is valuable.
You combine analytical depth with judgement. You can build and interrogate forecasts, quota models, capacity plans and commercial business cases.
You are hands-on and comfortable with ambiguity. You can move between shaping a commercial recommendation and investigating the underlying data or workflow. You have practical experience with CRM and analytical tools, such as Salesforce and Looker, and with automation or AI-enabled workflows.
Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 🔍 About Us
 CorePlan was born in Perth, Western Australia, and has since gone global. With another office in Vancouver and a team across 12 countries, we support customers around the world. Our cloud-native platform replaces legacy systems and spreadsheets with one intuitive, integrated tool that helps mining teams and their contractors plan, run and track their drilling programs.
We were recently named Western Australia Tech Company of the Year 2026 , an award that belongs to our whole team. We obsess over the customer experience and refuse to be lumped in with clunky enterprise software. Our goal is software that's as easy to use as the modern apps you rely on every day.
 The Role
 We are looking for a Sales Enablement Lead to shape how our customer-facing teams learn, sell and win. Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer, you will set the enablement strategy and own how our sellers are onboarded, trained, coached and supported, so they ramp faster, follow a consistent process and close more business with mining and drilling customers.
This is a chance to build the enablement function from the ground up. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success across Australia, EMEA, North America and Latin America, and your work will have a direct, measurable impact on revenue.
 🛠 What You Will Do
Design and own the sales enablement strategy and roadmap, aligned to our revenue and go-to-market goals
Assess current sales capability, spot the gaps and set clear priorities with sales leadership
Redesign and run a scalable onboarding program for new sales hires across all regions, with clear 30, 60 and 90 day plans and ramp milestones
Lead the rollout of the SPICED methodology through training, certification and call reviews
Build a coaching framework that helps sales leaders coach their teams consistently
Use Gong insights to identify skill gaps and share what great looks like across the team
Own our sales content and knowledge base in Notion, including playbooks, sequences, case studies and one pagers
Drive best practice use of our sales tech stack, including HubSpot, Gong, Fluint, PandaDoc, Clay and Lusha
Lead sales readiness for product releases and pricing changes, and keep the Sales to Customer Success handover clear
Define how enablement success is measured and report on impact, including ramp time, win rates and quota attainment
 🙌 What You Will Bring
At least 3 years in sales enablement, sales training or sales leadership in B2B, including building programs from scratch
A proven track record of improving seller performance, such as faster ramp time or higher win rates
Experience setting strategy and influencing senior stakeholders
A strong understanding of the full B2B sales cycle, ideally from time in a quota-carrying role
Excellent written communication and the ability to turn complex information into clear, practical resources
Confidence presenting, facilitating and coaching at all levels, including sales leaders
Hands-on CRM experience, ideally HubSpot
The ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
 Bonus Points If You Have
Familiarity with SPICED, MEDDIC or a similar sales methodology
Experience with Gong or other conversation intelligence tools
Experience supporting sales teams across multiple regions and time zones
Exposure to mining, drilling, resources or industrial sectors
 🚀 Why Our Team Loves Working Here
 High Impact & Real Autonomy
You will be building our enablement function from day one, with the freedom to shape it your way
Your programs will show up directly in ramp times, win rates and revenue
 Collaborative & Fast-Paced
Work side by side with our CRO and sales leaders, plus Marketing, Product and Customer Success
Support a global sales team across four regions, selling into a high value industry
 Vibrant Culture
Join a close-knit team of self-starters who back each other and celebrate the wins together
Be part of a growing tech company with real momentum shaping the future of mining tech
Modern office space, with vibrant office culture - music, pets, snacks and team events

Reshaping our pricing and packaging strategy

About Watershed
 Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.
We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!
The role
Watershed is on a mission to help companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions. Our go-to-market organization continues to grow, with an emphasis on scale and deepening our presence in EMEA. We're looking for a hands-on operator to run sales operations for the region and build the tools & processes our sellers rely on.
You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the team - forecasting, pipeline reviews, and planning - and dig into the data to identify risks and opportunities for growth.
This is a role for an operator who builds what they design and has already rewired their work around AI. Alongside the operating rhythm, your project work will be building AI agents, tools, and workflows that help our AEs, SDRs, and Solutions teams move our revenue metrics.
This position is based in our London office 4 days per week.
 You will:
Partner closely with EMEA sales leaders to shape and execute our growth strategy in the region
Support headcount, territory, and quota planning for the region, including account ownership and territory governance
Own the EMEA forecasting process: run regular forecast and pipeline reviews, and inspect deals to improve predictability
Define and track the metrics that show how our revenue teams are performing, and turn them into clear recommendations for leadership
Be the go-to resource for our London office on Salesforce and our revenue tech stack
Build AI-first workflows and internal tools, with tools like Claude Code, that change how our sales teams work day to day
 You have:
6+ years of work experience, including 3+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations at a high-growth B2B technology company
Direct experience supporting sales teams: you've run a forecast cadence, territory or quota planning, and the reporting behind a revenue number
Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building models and interpreting sales metrics
Hands-on experience with Salesforce: you build your own reports and dashboards. Bonus if you've owned administration, automation, or data model design
AI is already embedded in how you work. You've built AI workflows that other people use, not just prototypes
Strong communication skills: you turn data into clear recommendations for sales leadership and build trust across teams
 Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)
 Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.
 What’s the interview process like?
 It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.
 What if I need accommodations for my interview?
 At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

Competencies 
You are an applied AI engineer whose product is the revenue engine. You find where the customer lifecycle can work better and ship production-grade agentic workflow, LLM pipelines and integrations that make each process best in class for reps, CSMs and marketers. You operate independently and own each build end to end: architecture, prototype, evals, deployment and observability. You spar on solution design with the team, then ship.
We care more about what you have shipped than where you studied. If you have built something real, show us.
 Must-haves 
 You have shipped AI systems GTM teams use daily. Agents, workflows or integrations used by sales, CS or marketing that moved a number.
 Strong integration skills in JavaScript or TypeScript. You’re comfortable building and running integration services. Working with APIs and webhooks, handling auth, rate limits and errors, and shipping tested code.
 Hands-on Salesforce or equivalent, declarative and code. Declarative: object model, Flows, validation rules, permission sets, record types. Code: Apex triggers and classes, SOQL and SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Platform Events and Change Data Capture, REST and Bulk APIs, SFDX deployments.
 Applied AI engineering. You build with LLM APIs, not just chat interfaces, and can show the skills listed below in real work.
 You understand the revenue engine. Experience in RevOps, GTM Systems, growth or a GTM engineering agency in B2B SaaS. You know how pipeline, renewals and expansion actually work.
 Data quality fundamentals. SQL, CRM data models, deduplication, enrichment waterfalls and data quality at scale.
 GTM data stack. Clay, n8n, Make + warehouse and reverse ETL experience.
 Production mindset. You ship fast and build things others can maintain: logged, monitored, documented.
 Clear communicator. You can sit with a top rep, find the work that shouldn't exist, and explain the fix in plain words.
 Nice-to-haves 
Experience with a customer platform or CSM tool (Planhat, Gainsight, ChurnZero), or HubSpot alongside Salesforce.
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I or II, or Platform App Builder.
Side projects, open-source tools, public write-ups or a GitHub that shows you build for fun.
Founder, agency or early-stage startup experience.
 Trajectory 
You’ll own each build end to end, from architecture and prototype through evals, deployment and observability. Here’s what that looks like:
 Agentic GTM workflows: Design and ship AI agents and workflows that optimise productivity: account research, signal detection, enrichment, call and email analysis, personalised outreach, renewal and expansion plays.
 Planhat on Planhat: Run our own GTM on our own platform. Build with Planhat's AI, automations and APIs, and feed what you learn straight back to Product as a power user.
 Signals and data: Turn product usage, intent, firmographic and conversation data into scores and triggers that route the right account to the right person at the right time.
 Integrations: Connect tools that don't talk natively. Build the webhooks, MCP connection and transformations that keep data clean across the stack.
 Build vs buy: Run tight pilots on new GTM and AI tools, measure fit and ROI, and make a clear call.
 Enablement: Document what you build, teach teams to use it with confidence, and raise how the whole company builds with AI.
 Definition of Success 
Success is measured in outcomes: productivity gains, pipeline acceleration, data quality and adoption of what you ship.

This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. 
 About Float 
Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 
As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025 , 2024 and 2023 , Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.
At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.
 Our Product 
Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C , and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.
Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.
 AI Use in Our Hiring Process 
We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.
 About the Role 
Float is building out its next stage of growth operations. As Revenue Operations Manager, you’ll own the systems, programs, and operating rhythms that take a prospect from first touch to active, spending customer.
You’ll build, not inherit. This role is for someone who gets excited about being a high impact individual contributor. You’ll partner with Sales, BDR, Partnerships, Marketing Ops, Finance, Product, and Customer Success leadership to turn strategy into repeatable programs that improve pipeline quality, conversion, and activation.
 What You'll Do 
Design and optimize the end-to-end sales-acquired customer journey. This starts with ISR/BDR (Team of 3) prospecting inbound and outbound, AE (Team of 10) sales funnel management and deal execution, customer activation (Team of 5) through first card usage (months 0–4).
Own and optimize the Acquisition operating system: outbound cadences, deal-execution playbooks, funnel performance insights and oversight, and the activation ramp that converts a signed contract into usage (maximizing spend penetration).
Evaluate, implement, and optimize the acquisition tech stack (sales engagement, Salesforce pipeline configuration), driving adoption across BDR and AE teams.
Own pipeline health: coverage ratios, stage conversion, win/loss analysis
Build and own forecasting and quota-setting for sales-acquired TPV, and partner with Marketing Ops on the self-serve-to-sales handoff.
Build scalable territory and account-assignment programs for BDR/AE capacity.
Partner with BDR/AE leadership on reporting cadences, monetization levers (e.g. contract terms), operating rhythms, and performance metrics.
Own streamlining handoffs from Marketing > BDR, BDR > AE, and AE to Customer Activation teams
Translate fragmented pipeline and activation data into recommendations for Sales and GTM leadership.
Identify and automate manual 
[...]
 than owning the systems behind it.
You'd rather report on pipeline metrics than build what generates them.
 Our Hiring Philosophy 
We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.
 Why You Should Join 
Be part of an award winning company: we're one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2026 according to Report on Business , and Deloitte’s Technology Fast50 2026
Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters
 In Short 
At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you. 
 Protect yourself from recruiting scams. Float only contacts candidates from @ floatfinancial.com addresses and schedules interviews through Ashby or Float calendar invites. We will never ask you to install software, pay a fee, buy equipment or share bank or card details. If something looks off, don't engage. 
 We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic ( victoria@floatfinancial.com ), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.
